nodes.label: SEC Theme Colors
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for the 18 CSS data-theme keys and the themes seed documents.

nodes.label: Eighteen Theme Catalog
nodes.rationale: Closed catalog of 18 themes. themePath is the theme key and must not begin with /. Default is light. Users on a deactivated theme keep it until they pick another.

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Every theme supplies CSS custom properties from --color-bg through --color-danger. Components use semantic utilities and never hard-code a hex. Selector is [data-theme] on html.

nodes.label: WCAG AA Theme Contrast
nodes.rationale: Text on surfaces and primary-fg on primary must meet WCAG AA. Very dark primaries use a light neutral page surface with the team color on chrome, not as the full-page background.

nodes.label: Success and Danger Pick Icons
nodes.rationale: Correct and incorrect pick icons always use --color-success and --color-danger, not school colors.
